surface_taxonomy.FILE_READ: Read file contents including text, code, data, images
surface_taxonomy.FILE_WRITE: Create or modify files or directories
surface_taxonomy.REPO_WRITE: Modify repository files including code and tests
surface_taxonomy.LOG_READ: Read log files generated by programs or tools
surface_taxonomy.METADATA_READ: Read metadata using specialized tools such as exiftool
surface_taxonomy.ERROR_MESSAGE: Consume stderr, warnings, stack traces, and error messages
surface_taxonomy.GENERATED_ARTIFACT_READ: Read files previously generated by the agent itself
surface_taxonomy.NETWORK_ATTEMPT: Make network requests using curl, wget, or HTTP libraries
